notes:
Compress PDF now has one control with three levels: Extreme, Recommended and Less.

All three resize and re-encode the pictures inside your PDF while leaving every word of text exactly as it was. Print-ready documents finally compress properly — a 1073-page technical book goes from 53.7 MB to about 14 MB, where before it managed 3%.

Before you start, the panel tells you what the file is made of and what the chosen level will do about it.
